response.sql: WITH mix_counts AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS mix, COUNT(*) AS mix_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = a.translink GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), mix_shares AS (SELECT mix, mix_count, mix_count::numeric / SUM(mix_count) OVER () AS share FROM mix_counts), compared AS (SELECT mix, mix_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average_share FROM mix_shares) SELECT mix, mix_count, share, above_average_share FROM compared WHERE above_average_share > 0 ORDER BY above_average_share DESC;
